g.text: B The same witness designs fail when reference assumptions change

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #173246
font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a34525

g.text: SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD • Not biological sufficiency or a rating of any real study

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: Baseline: R = 4, B = 1, S = 0.25, independent repeats. All precision targets use likelihood information.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: P = all required targets in the category pass F = at least one fails ? = unresolved – = not required

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: Witness schedules: AB1, days 0/30 and two balanced groups; AB2, days 0/30/365 and four factorial groups.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: Depth = effective independent reference repeats per coordinate per occasion when ρ = 0; correlated repeats provide less information.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: *Cortical causality is an optional named child. Core neural columns concern observation. Missing neural evidence stays unknown.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #354c5c

g.text: Categories partition the frozen targets; digital/neural columns include their state, population and temporal targets. No scalar score.
